Preference.app:title: Display controls
Preference.app:summary: Refresh mode, image adjustments, and frontlights

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Default image contrast
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Applies to apps using the default. 0 is unchanged. Higher values can hide gray detail.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Default grey darkness
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Makes greys darker while white stays white (helps light-grey keyboard symbols). 0 is unchanged.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Fast keyboard
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Use a fast display mode while the keyboard is visible. Restore the app's display mode when it closes.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Live scrolling in reading apps
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Keeps the screen following continuous scrolling in readers such as ReadEra, whose frames the display would otherwise skip.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Clean after touches in reading apps
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: For readers that never report scrolling (such as ReadEra). Also flashes after menu taps.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Clean notification shade
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Flash once after the notification shade opens or closes. Off by default: the light shade leaves little ghosting, and the clean briefly slows the panel.
